text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring at 80% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff off. This balances visibility for keyboard users with subtlety to avoid visual clutter. The trade-off is slightly less contrast than the 4px ring, but it preserves screen space on mobile and aligns with WCAG’s 3:1 minimum for focus indicators.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 80% opacity still fails WCAG 2.1 AA on dark backgrounds—contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 4px ring at 100% opacity with a 1px inner white off-set meets WCAG while keeping visual weight balanced. Test both in a dark theme with a screen reader and high-contrast mode to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring at 100% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff offset. This meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on dark backgrounds while remaining visible for keyboard users. The trade-off is slightly more screen space used, but it guarantees accessibility for users with low vision or high-contrast mode. Test it in both light and dark themes to confirm.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks visual weight dominating on small interactive elements like buttons or form fields, especially in dense UIs. A better alternative is a 3px ring at 90% opacity with a 1px inner white offset—this keeps contrast above 4.5:1 on dark backgrounds while reducing bulk. Settle it by testing in a dark theme with high-contrast mode and screen reader users to confirm both visibility and subtlety.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring at 90% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff offset. The result must deliver a tested, WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant focus indicator across dark backgrounds, mobile, and high-contrast modes, owned by the accessibility team.
